cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - AirPurifier
cc:Work.dc:description:
Housing for the Nukit Open Air Purifier
See [Nukit Open Air Purifier](https://github.com/opennukit/Nukit-Open-Air-Purifier/)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes AirPurifier --x 300 --y 300 --fan_diameter 92 --fans_top 1 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes AirPurifier --x --y --fan_diameter --fans_top --reference
